notes.title: WE'RE A TIGA AWARDS FINALIST! PLUS, 20% DISCOUNT ALL THIS WEEK!
notes.content:
[h3]The finalists for this year's TIGA Games Industry Awards have been announced and A Musical Story has been nominated in the 'Audio Design' category! [/h3]

We're in formidable company, with big hitters including Horizon Forbidden West, The Quarry, and Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy also in the running. It's a huge achievement to be recognised in these awards, so massive congratulations to developer Glee-Cheese Studio – it's well deserved!

The awards take place 10th November. You can see the [url=https://tiga.org/news/the-finalists-of-the-tiga-games-industry-awards-2022-are-announced][b]full list of finalists at the TIGA site[/b][/url].

And if you haven't grabbed A Musical Story yet, now's an ideal time as it's on sale all this week with a 20% discount.

notes.title: A MUSICAL STORY IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Is everybody in? The gear's loaded. The band's all here. It's time to hit the road for an unforgettable trip – A Musical Story has launched and is available to download now![/b][/h3]

Play music to unlock the memories of guitarist, Gabriel, in a story without words. Follow the highs and lows of the band as they chase their dream of performing at the legendary Pinewood Festival. 

[previewyoutube=J9WSIlZ0iJ0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Before you head off to start jamming, some launch day notes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]A Digital Deluxe Edition is also available[/b] (and with a 10% launch discount). It includes the full game, official soundtrack featuring 26 original songs, digital artbook showcasing in-game and unused imagery, and six wallpapers
[*] For information regarding accessibility features, full details can be found in this [b][url=https://www.taminggaming.com/en-us/accessibility/A+Musical+Story]accessibility report [/url][/b]
[*] If you play A Musical Story and would like to leave some feedback, go ahead and drop it here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1546100/discussions/0/3193620054614312527/][b]A Musical Story | Game Feedback[/b][/url]
[*] If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please report them in this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1546100/discussions/0/3193620054614311322/][b]A Musical Story | Bug Reports[/b][/url]
[*] A Musical Story has also launched on PS4, PS5, Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, iOS, and Android
[*] If you enjoy A Musical Story, [b]please consider leaving a user review[/b]. Every review really helps.
[/list]

[h3][b]Some review quotes and scores:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [i]"One of the best rhythm games in recent memory... a work of art"[/i] [b][url=https://www.nintendoworldreport.com/review/59822/a-musical-story-switch-review]Nintendo World Report (9.5/10)[/url][/b]
[*] [i]"You will instantly forge connections with the protagonist and invest in the story... an unforgettable experience"[/i] [url=https://cogconnected.com/review/a-musical-story-review/][b]COG Connected (8/10)[/b][/url]
[*] [i]"A beautiful audio-visual treat... the music is a wonderful blend of psychedelic 70's rock and lo-fi beats and I want more of it"[/i] [url=https://xboxaddict.com/Staff-Review/14642/A-Musical-Story-Review.html][b]XboxAddict (8.2/10)[/b][/url]
[*] [i]"This short but very sweet experience had me hooked from start to finish" [/i][url=https://www.xboxtavern.com/a-musical-story-review/][b]Xbox Tavern (9.2/10)[/b][/url]
[*] [i]"The cooler, arty cousin of genre stalwarts such as Rock Band and Guitar Hero... you’ll feel a buzz of adrenaline each time you smash your solo"[/i] [url=https://averagejoegames.com/a-musical-story-review/][b]Average Joe Gaming (9/10)[/b][/url]
[/list]

Finally, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported A Musical Story on its journey to launch. We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: ACCOLADES AND AWARDS FOR A MUSICAL STORY!
notes.content:
[i][b]Wanted to share the news that A Musical Story recently received two 'Honorable Mentions' as part of this year's Independent Games Festival Awards. It was recognised in the 'Excellence in Audio' and 'Excellence in Visual Art' categories. [/b][/i]

There were over 400 entries, so for A Musical Story to be shortlisted TWICE is a wonderful achievement and testament to the talents of developer Glee-Cheese Studio. The IGF Awards take place in March as part of GDC 2022. You can find the [url=https://igf.com/article/unpacking-and-inscryption-lead-igf-2022-nominations][b]full list of Finalists and Honorable Mentions here[/b][/url].

And the accolades don't stop there – A Musical Story is a finalist in the 'Best Audio' category at the upcoming [url=https://tgs.tca.org.tw/indie_award_finalist.php?b=2b_e][b]Taipei Game Show '2022 Indie Game Awards'[/b][/url] (winners will be announced later this month), and at the end of last year it won 'Best Art Direction' at the [url=https://indiex.online/][b]Indie X Awards[/b][/url]. 

Huge congrats to the team at Glee-Cheese Studio!

In other news, we're delighted to say we will be able to confirm a release date for A Musical Story very soon. Stay tuned!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Digerati][b]Matt | Digerati[/b][/url]
